import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
from scipy.special import logsumexp
def lE(y,nu,x,N=5):
    r=np.arange(-N,N+1)
    I,J=np.meshgrid(r,r); I=I.ravel();J=J.ravel()
    m=(I!=0)|(J!=0)
    z=(I+x*J+1j*y*J)[m]/np.sqrt(y)
    A=z[:,None];B=z[None,:]
    d=np.abs(A-B); mask=d>1e-12
    p=(np.abs(A)*np.abs(B))*np.where(mask,d,1)
    return logsumexp(-nu*np.log(p[mask]))
for x in [0,0.5]:
  for nu in [10,20,40,80,160,320]:
    r=minimize_scalar(lambda y:lE(y,nu,x),bounds=(0.8,2.5),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-12})
    print(x,nu,r.x,r.fun)
